content: A score of 5 or higher on the American Diabetes Association (ADA) Risk Score indicates an elevated risk of developing type 2 diabetes. It is strongly advised to consult a healthcare professional for further diagnostic testing and evaluation. The risk of type 2 diabetes is notably higher among individuals of African American, Hispanic/Latino, Native American, Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander descent. Additionally, individuals with higher body weight are at an increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
